Hotel software & PMS

Make your POS and hotel software work together.

Hotel software is often called a PMS, Property Management System. A suitable integration exchanges data with your POS. We check features for the specific package and versions.

  • Look up and check room or guest data
  • Transfer consumptions and financial postings
  • Process corrections and return statuses

Define the lead application for reservations, room types, rates, check-in and check-out rather than managing the same data in several places.

Fiscal setup

Hotel billing and hospitality: make the right distinction.

Hotels can combine activities. How accommodation, meals and drinks are charged matters for GKS assessment. Have your accountant review the workflow before deciding fiscal configuration.

Overall hotel bill

FPS Finance distinguishes activities for staying guests settled through the overall hotel bill. This treatment must not automatically be equated with separate restaurant activities.

Source: FPS Finance — what changes for hotels?

Other hospitality activities

Restaurant or bar transactions outside the overall hotel bill need separate assessment, such as meals for non-residents. Also check GKS 2.0 requirements if your activity is subject to GKS.

Read about GKS 2.0 and transition dates. Legal information checked on 8 November 2026.

Practical answers

Frequently asked questions about hotel POS systems.

Can restaurant or bar purchases be charged to a room?

This needs checking for your hotel software and POS combination, including room and guest identification, posting consumptions and corrections.

Will a new POS work with my current hotel software?

We check the specific hotel package or PMS, version and available integration. Not every POS supports every hotel application. Features and extra modules are discussed beforehand.

Can I split a bill across multiple rooms?

It depends on software and setup. Demonstrate group bills, partial payments and splitting across rooms so those scenarios can be tested.

Can I manage check-in, check-out and room rates in the POS?

These functions often belong to hotel software or a dedicated module. We decide which application manages rooms and what data the POS needs. Options vary by solution.

How do I restrict staff access to data?

Set suitable roles: who can correct sales, charge rooms or view reports? Account and everyday use arrangements also matter.

Can I view figures for multiple departments or sites?

We check software and reporting. Specify breakdowns for bar, restaurant and other outlets, and whether central multi-site management is available.

Is a registered POS mandatory in a hotel?

Assessment distinguishes activities on the overall hotel bill from other hospitality activities. A hotel restaurant serving outside guests needs separate assessment. Check your situation against official GKS guidance.

What does a hotel POS with integrations cost?

It depends on workstations, hardware, hotel integration and modules. Ask for clear one-off and recurring costs, installation and support.
